ops.old: Whipped feta with lemon and chilli oil beside smoky baba ghanoush, scooped up with warm oven-baked pita chips. Not a prawn in sight. Heat the oven to 220C. Prick 2 eggplants and roast 40 minutes until collapsed, then scoop the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 crushed garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest until smooth, then drizzle with 1 tbsp chilli oil. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with olive oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp.
